policy:
The controlled historical sweep is complete: 109/109 game comparisons, 872/872 valid observations and 20 retained earlier invalid attempts. All saved plans and observations are preserved. Winners were reassessed on the current runtime before graduation; individual percentages are not additive.

Compiled syscalls, sparse ROM lookup and outlined entry budgets were adopted in 632c3d433. The resumed sweep additionally graduated forward-only leaves at bound 32 (21c322713), single-branch veneers (0b890a26a), and register-only tail prefixes (7f5f85273). Those graduated choices remain the browser defaults.

The final direct measurement of those three later graduations together versus 632c3d433 gives Snakes +2.56% CPU throughput (4/4 faster pairs) and Sky Force -1.80% (2/4 faster pairs). This is a measured tradeoff, not a demonstrated two-game win. All 16 observations are valid and all 88 restoration checks pass. See [combined results and limitations](SWEEP_COMBINED_RESULTS.md). No new promotion or rollback follows from this closing comparison; the Sky Force regression is explicitly recorded for targeted isolation.

The graduated artifact passed 175 compiler tests and real LAN gameplay/input checks. Full live-audio E2E remains blocked by the previously reproduced host audio-device failure; exact PCM replays pass. Temperature ceilings and cooldown waits are removed; measured clock, throttle, affinity and counter checks remain. No benchmark or graduation is queued.

The subsequent [56-entry source audit and cleanup](RETIRED_SWEEP_EXPERIMENTS.md) removes division lowering, entry-only pruning, count batching, inline entry-budget recovery and adjustable execution limits. The other listed implementations were already absent or superseded. Adopted behavior remains; this maintenance change has no new timing claim. Historical measurements and candidate patches remain available.

The requested [incoming-pointer lifetime proof](POINTER_LIFETIME_RESULTS.md) is adopted for direct-memory ARM regions under the full-entry budget. Against b96296d58, Snakes improves +1.87% CPU throughput with all four pairs faster and -0.94% native instructions. Sky Force averages +0.14% with mixed pairs and essentially unchanged native instructions, so no Sky Force gain is established. All 16 observations and 88 restoration checks pass; both games pass exact image, instruction-progress and PCM replays. This was a separate requested optimization, not a resumed sweep. At the conclusion of that experiment, the measured artifact was served on LAN and both game-picker gameplay/input checks passed. The existing host audio-device failure remains; full live-audio E2E is not claimed.

The requested [deferred comparison flags across successful reads](DEFERRED_COMPARE_MEMORY_RESULTS.md) experiment is not adopted. V8 retains flag work that the prototype removes: sixteen fewer native instructions on each of four audited successful scheduler loop paths. In current-runtime ABBA/BAAB measurements, Snakes is effectively flat (+0.19% CPU throughput, 3/4 faster pairs), while Sky Force averages -1.12% with mixed pairs despite -2.00% native instructions. All 16 observations, exact state/replay checks and 88 host-restoration checks pass. The full candidate is archived as a patch; its compiler changes and test hooks are removed from active source. That experiment left production and LAN on the prior lifetime-proof build.

The requested [complete division-helper summary](DIVISION_HELPER_RESULTS.md) is adopted without a runtime selector. Against ff89d6335, Snakes improves +5.80% CPU throughput with 4/4 faster pairs and -6.06% native instructions. Sky Force averages +0.21% with 1/4 faster pairs; no Sky Force gain is established. It recognizes the full algorithm by instruction bytes at any address and summarizes large-quotient calls; smaller calls, exceptions and short budgets retain the original body. Intermediate state work disappears; final scratch outputs remain because no caller proves them dead. All 16 timing observations, exact state/replay checks and 88 host-restoration checks pass. At the conclusion of that experiment, the measured build was served on LAN and both games passed gameplay/input checks. The existing host audio-device failure remains. This is a separately requested optimization; the historical sweep remains complete.

The requested [fixed syscall dispatch and same-thread context reuse](KERNEL_DISPATCH_RESULTS.md) are adopted together without a selector. Against 584d70a92, Sky Force CPU throughput improves 3.05% (3/4 faster pairs), while Snakes loses 1.51% (0/4 faster); this is an explicit tradeoff for Sky Force, not a two-game win. The syscall-only alternative measures Snakes -2.36% and Sky Force +1.11%. Both campaigns retain all valid results and pass 88 restoration checks each; one invalid Sky Force attempt in each campaign during unrelated builds is retained and individually retried. Registry/OS-return tests, full-state context tests, 178-test AOT suite and both exact game replays pass, with the pre-existing harness XFAIL documented. The measured combined artifact is now on LAN; gameplay/input checks pass. The existing browser audio limitation remains. This was a separately requested optimization; the historical sweep remains complete.

The [native ARM and C++ attribution investigation](NATIVE_ATTRIBUTION_RESULTS.md) adds optional source metadata and samples actual warmed V8 machine code. Two Sky Force captures agree on C++ runtime at 55–56% and generated guest code at about 40% of guest-worker samples. The compiled-region call sequence contains about 11%, and sparse ROM successor lookup 6.5–7%; these are native sample ranges, not predicted speedups. Exact source-anchor coverage is 19–20%, with V8’s missing arithmetic positions kept explicit. Both captures, 178 AOT tests, and an exact 60-frame Sky Force image/audio/progress replay pass. This is profiling infrastructure and localization, with no runtime optimization adopted or production deployment.

The [Thumb-to-ROM veneer handoff optimization](ROM_LEAF_HANDOFF_RESULTS.md) is adopted without a selector. Against 6eb59dbc2, Sky Force improves +3.19% CPU throughput with 4/4 faster pairs and -2.41% retired native instructions; Snakes averages -0.38% with mixed pairs and unchanged native instruction count. All 16 valid observations are retained, together with one invalid control attempt that failed an interval-clock rule and was individually retried. The 179-test AOT suite, 34,560 focused state comparisons, both exact game replays and all 88 restoration checks pass. Actual warmed V8 code confirms that the caller executes the runtime literal load and skips one lookup/call/return boundary. This is a separately requested optimization; the historical sweep remains complete.

The [combined ROM veneer and syscall-stub handoff optimization](ROM_SYSCALL_HANDOFF_RESULTS.md) is committed in 2fb8a3b85 and 0b6aabed4 and enabled under the existing defaults without a new selector. Measured directly against 6eb59dbc2, both changes together improve Sky Force CPU throughput +8.95% (4/4 faster pairs) and reduce retired native instructions 4.06%; Snakes averages -0.69% with 2/4 faster pairs. These combined percentages replace, rather than add to, the preceding single-stage comparison. Unpaced wall speeds at the controlled 3.6 GHz clock are Snakes 2.09x realtime and Sky Force combat 0.72x. All 16 observations and 88 host-restoration checks pass. The combined build passes 194,560 syscall state comparisons, existing SVC/veneer/call boundary checks and both exact image/progress/PCM replays. The measured combined artifact is served on LAN; both real game-picker gameplay/input/default-policy checks pass. The existing browser audio failure remains. That capture identified the ARM BX-LR and Thumb POP-PC return paths as the next candidate; the subsequent measured result is recorded below. The historical sweep remains complete.

The requested [post-SVC return continuation](SVC_RETURN_CONTINUATION_RESULTS.md) is adopted by default without a new selector. Against af7d76628, Sky Force CPU throughput changes +2.48% (4/4 faster pairs) with -1.61% native instructions; Snakes changes -1.34% (0/4 faster pairs). These are incremental results over both prior adopted handoff optimizations, not additive percentages. All 16 timing observations and 88 restoration checks pass; 0 invalid attempts are retained. The full 183-test suite, 600 eligibility cases, 14,976 return-state comparisons, 480 real-core comparisons and both exact image/progress/PCM replays pass. Actual warmed native code confirms that the successful continuation skips both return-region calls and lookups. The measured artifact is served on LAN and both game-picker gameplay/input/default-policy checks pass. The existing browser audio failure remains. The historical sweep remains complete.

The [immutable Thumb helper inlining experiment](THUMB_ROM_LEAF_RESULTS.md) is not adopted; its prototype is archived and removed from active source. Against 536ea5af3, Snakes CPU throughput changes +0.24% (2/4 faster pairs), and Sky Force -2.29% (1/4 faster pairs). Native instruction changes are -0.05% and -1.24%, respectively. The prototype does not earn adoption: Sky Force loses 2.29% CPU throughput, with three of four pairs slower, despite 1.24% fewer native instructions. Snakes is effectively flat (+0.24%, mixed pairs). The subsequent single-budget-proof result is recorded below. All 16 valid timing observations and 88 restoration checks pass; 0 invalid attempts remain archived. Independent state checks, both exact game replays and the warmed V8 audit pass. The historical sweep remains complete.

The [single-budget-proof Thumb helper follow-up](THUMB_LEAF_BUDGET_RESULTS.md) is not adopted; the prototype and test hooks are archived and removed. Against the same adopted 536ea5af3 control, Snakes CPU throughput changes -0.15% (2/4 faster pairs), and Sky Force -0.88% (1/4 faster pairs). Native instruction changes are -0.01% and -1.29%, respectively. The smaller native body does not earn adoption: Sky Force loses 0.88% CPU throughput, with three of four pairs slower, despite 1.29% fewer retired native instructions. Snakes is effectively flat (-0.15%, mixed pairs). Together with the first rejected variant, this establishes a local stopping point for these helper-inlining follow-ups, not an overall emulator performance ceiling. The existing defaults are retained. All 16 valid observations and 88 restoration checks pass, with 0 retained invalid attempts. Both exact game replays and independent state checks pass; warmed V8 confirms the sampled caller shrank from 1472 to 896 native bytes. The historical sweep remains complete. The requested hot-path round stops here after two runtime-negative helper-inlining variants. Production source, rebuilt artifacts and the live LAN WASM exactly match the preceding adopted default; no new runtime winner was graduated. Both campaigns retain all 32 valid observations with zero invalid attempts.

The completed [broader profile-driven hotspot round](HOTSPOT_ROUND_RESULTS.md) adopts seven winners; its direct combined result is recorded below. [Static built-in syscall bindings](STATIC_SVC_BINDINGS_RESULTS.md) are adopted without a selector: Sky Force gains +2.53% CPU throughput across the initial and confirmation batches (7/8 faster pairs), with -2.17% retired native instructions. Snakes is effectively unchanged (+0.19%, 2/4). All 24 valid observations are retained, including the slower candidate; zero invalid attempts. Both batches pass all 88 host-restoration checks. Native/WASM registry tests, exact both-game replays and real LAN gameplay/input/default-policy checks pass. The existing live-audio failure remains. The subsequent candidates and final direct combined comparison are recorded below.

The hotspot round additionally adopts [empty exclusive-monitor clearing](EMPTY_MONITOR_CLEAR_RESULTS.md) without a selector. Against static syscall bindings, Sky Force gains +3.38% CPU throughput (3/4 faster pairs), with -0.51% retired native instructions; Snakes remains flat (-0.09%, 2/4). All 16 valid observations, including the slower pair, are retained; zero invalid attempts. The 254,406-case native/WASM reservation tests, exact both-game image/progress/PCM replays, 88 host-restoration checks and real LAN gameplay/input/default-policy checks pass. The existing live browser-audio failure remains. This is incremental evidence; the final combined result is recorded below.

The hotspot round adopts the [linked-list scan summary](LIST_SCAN_RESULTS.md) without a selector. Against 7a5ec3472, Sky Force gains +5.61% CPU throughput (4/4 faster pairs), with -7.75% retired native instructions; Snakes is flat (-0.16%). All 16 valid observations, 184 AOT tests, 54,720 independent scan-state comparisons, exact both-game replays and 88 host-restoration checks pass. The measured artifact is served on LAN; real gameplay/input/default checks pass. The pre-existing browser-audio failure remains. Further independent runtime candidates are still being evaluated.

The hotspot round adopts [private runner counters and once-per-chain registry acquisition](RUNNER_LOCALS_RESULTS.md): Snakes +3.01% CPU throughput (4/4 faster pairs), -2.49% native instructions; Sky Force +5.84% CPU throughput (4/4 faster pairs), -2.67% native instructions. 504 real runner policy/mutation cases and the existing SVC/registry/cache/verifier checks pass. The actual warmed native body loses the result stores and repeated initialization guard. The measured artifact is served on LAN; real gameplay/input/default checks pass. The pre-existing browser-audio failure remains. Subsequent memory/monitor/audio verdicts are recorded below. All 16 valid observations, exact both-game replays and 88 restoration checks pass; 0 invalid attempts.

The hotspot round does not adopt [folded ROM range checks](ROM_RANGE_RESULTS.md): Snakes +0.02% CPU throughput (2/4 faster pairs), +0.19% native instructions; Sky Force +0.26% CPU throughput (2/4 faster pairs), -0.89% native instructions. The source is restored; the archived patch remains available. A smaller registry-only candidate is measured separately. All 16 valid observations, exact both-game replays and 88 restoration checks pass; 0 invalid attempts.

The hotspot round adopts [registry-only ROM range check](ROM_REGISTRY_RANGE_RESULTS.md): Snakes +0.01% CPU throughput (1/4 faster pairs), -0.14% native instructions; Sky Force +1.47% CPU throughput (3/4 faster pairs), -0.73% native instructions. Only the private registry bounds simplification is retained. The outer runtime classifier remains unchanged; no new selector is added. All 16 valid observations, exact both-game replays and 88 restoration checks pass; 0 invalid attempts.

The hotspot round adopts [packed monitor reservation summary](PACKED_MONITOR_RESULTS.md): Snakes -0.10% CPU throughput (1/4 faster pairs), -0.00% native instructions; Sky Force +3.83% CPU throughput (4/4 faster pairs), +0.04% native instructions. The packed monitor is enabled without a selector. Shared-monitor synchronization and concurrent reservations remain supported. A tiny Snakes loss is accepted for the consistent Sky Force gain. The hotspot round does not adopt [CPU-owned browser reservation monitor](CONFINED_MONITOR_RESULTS.md): Snakes -0.09% CPU throughput (2/4 faster pairs), -0.01% native instructions; Sky Force +0.93% CPU throughput (2/4 faster pairs), -0.23% native instructions. The hotspot round adopts [Exact-order audio interpolation SIMD](AUDIO_SIMD_RESULTS.md): Snakes -0.47% CPU throughput (0/4 faster pairs), -0.01% native instructions; Sky Force +3.03% CPU throughput (4/4 faster pairs), -0.72% native instructions. Enabled without a selector. All four Sky Force pairs are faster, but the +8.86% pair inflates the +3.03% mean; the other pairs are +0.80% to +1.33%. Accept the smaller 0.47% Snakes cost. Do not add this incremental mean to other gains. All 16 valid observations, exact both-game replays and 88 restoration checks pass; 0 invalid attempts.

The broader hotspot round is complete with seven default-enabled runtime winners. The direct combined comparison against 536ea5af3 measures Snakes +4.60% CPU and +3.64% wall throughput, 4/4 faster CPU pairs; Sky Force +14.23% CPU and +12.81% wall throughput, 4/4 faster CPU pairs. See [round results](HOTSPOT_ROUND_RESULTS.md); incremental gains are not added. Three unearned prototypes are archived and removed. Remaining dispatch/state-transfer costs are documented; this is a local stopping point, not a global ceiling.

The region-fusion round adopts [Connected Thumb region fusion](REGION_FUSION_RESULTS.md): Snakes -0.91% CPU throughput (1/4 faster pairs), -1.33% native instructions; Sky Force +5.73% CPU throughput (4/4 faster pairs), -9.31% native instructions. Adopted with the explicitly accepted small Snakes tradeoff; bounded-budget changes remain a separate experiment. All 16 valid observations, exact both-game replays and 88 restoration checks pass; 0 invalid attempts.

The region-fusion round adopts [Whole-path Thumb budget proof](THUMB_REGION_BUDGET_RESULTS.md): Snakes +0.25% CPU throughput (2/4 faster pairs), -0.26% native instructions; Sky Force +2.63% CPU throughput (4/4 faster pairs), -2.63% native instructions. One static entry proof replaces per-instruction checks on eligible bounded Thumb paths. Precise cold recovery retains existing scheduling and single-step boundaries; no quantum overshoot is enabled. All 16 valid observations, exact both-game replays and 88 restoration checks pass; 0 invalid attempts.

The region-fusion round does not adopt [Bounded Thumb loop wrapper removal](THUMB_LINEAR_REGION_RESULTS.md): Snakes +0.66% CPU throughput (2/4 faster pairs), -0.13% native instructions; Sky Force +0.57% CPU throughput (3/4 faster pairs), -0.49% native instructions. Inconclusive runtime benefit despite fewer native instructions and eliminated loop-header checks. Prototype archived and removed; b57a12bbe remains the served default. All 16 valid observations, exact both-game replays and 88 restoration checks pass; 0 invalid attempts.

The region-fusion round does not adopt [Known Thumb return fusion](THUMB_RETURN_FUSION_RESULTS.md): Snakes -0.13% CPU throughput (2/4 faster pairs), -0.01% native instructions; Sky Force -2.39% CPU throughput (1/4 faster pairs), -1.98% native instructions. The guarded-return prototype did not earn graduation and is removed. The earlier shared-local fusion and exact bounded entry-budget proof remain enabled; no quantum overshoot is enabled. All 16 valid observations, exact both-game replays and 88 restoration checks pass; 0 invalid attempts.

The [native handoff investigation](HANDOFF_NATIVE_PROFILE_RESULTS.md) on watchdog-only browser runtime 0e354cd12 adopts no new optimization. Actual warmed instruction samples put V8 indirect calls at 11.34% of Snakes / 6.42% of Sky Force worker samples, and inlined RAM hits at 8.47% / 2.53%. Combined identity checks do not reduce executed native instruction count; an arithmetic PC mask reduces its sequence from nine to seven instructions but has no established runtime gain. Both prototypes are archived and removed. Short fixed-clock screens have unequal gameplay work and cannot establish small gains or regressions; all host settings were restored. The existing LAN artifact remains served. Historical budget-based results above are not measurements of this count-free runtime.

The [direct region tail-chain experiment](DIRECT_CHAIN_RESULTS.md) is archived with no runtime/default/LAN change. A real-runner exact-work Chrome microbenchmark improves 4.665x and retires 61.97% fewer native instructions. The eight fixed-clock game observations are effectively flat (Snakes +0.19%, Sky Force +0.05% observed CPU throughput) and have unequal gameplay work, so neither is an established game gain. Six hottest generated Sky Force functions have no direct links; linked functions in matched snapshots contribute 5.62% of worker samples, not a taken-edge count. The candidate passes 146 focused checks and reports 182 full-suite passes; both games reach gameplay and all host settings restore. The tested patch and evidence are preserved; only the post-measurement screenshot-dialog fix remains active.

The [caller-specific stack-return experiment](STACK_RETURN_RESULTS.md) reaches Sky Force's hot pixel converter through a private direct WASM call, but is not adopted. A fixed-work test of 1,000 full-image conversions measures +0.109% CPU throughput and -0.0064% native instructions across four faster pairs. Clock-valid gameplay windows still execute different scenes and amounts of work; the final Sky Force arithmetic mean (+1.60% CPU throughput, +2.07% native instructions, mixed pairs) is not an established speedup. The other four hot stack-returning functions use a function table and remain outside direct-call coverage. The complete candidate passes 182 compiler tests, including 384 focused state/memory/callback and 32 independent interpreter comparisons. The implementation, fixtures and browser driver are archived as a reproducible patch. Runtime defaults and the frozen LAN deployment remain unchanged; all eight host-control invocations restore successfully.

The [shared-local indirect-call fusion](FUSED_INDIRECT_CALL_RESULTS.md) follow-up is enabled by default. Guarded ARM BLX candidates and matching stack returns share the caller's WASM locals, eliminating successful dispatcher handoffs and intermediate CPU-state publication/reload. The actual captured tile-row caller, with eight candidate callees, improves +34.29% CPU throughput and retires 16.02% fewer native instructions across four faster fixed-work pairs. Its call/return loop accounts for 30.49% of sampled stock Sky Force handoffs, not CPU samples. The final short Sky Force screen observes +1.68% CPU throughput and -1.26% native instructions, but unequal gameplay work prevents an established whole-game percentage. Snakes menu timing is excluded. All 182 compiler tests pass, including 2,880 state/memory/callback and 240 independent interpreter comparisons. Both games pass real paced gameplay/input checks; sound is muted. The measured artifact is served on LAN with its downloaded hash verified. All six host-control invocations restore, including the rejected setup and intentionally stopped menu attempt. The earlier direct-call expansion remains archived; this is a generic indirect-call compiler change, with no game-specific production patterns.

The [constant-time indirect target table](INDIRECT_TARGET_TABLE_RESULTS.md) removes the arbitrary eight-target cap in an archived prototype. All twelve captured Sky Force tile targets are selected; 96-target correctness tests and all 182 compiler tests pass. Actual warmed native code uses an indexed jump. With corrected tiering warmup, one-fast-case/table CPU throughput is -4.32% for the main tile path, +3.57% additive, and +3.84% subtractive. An eight-case fixed prefix plus table is +0.51%, -1.12%, and +1.74%, respectively; eight is a comparison prefix, not a target cap. These are fixed renderer workloads, not whole-game gains, and do not establish a worthwhile new default. Both candidate layouts are archived; runtime and LAN remain on the existing fusion. Retained benchmark improvements add both blending workloads and verify completed normal V8 root tiering before timing. All host settings restore.

The [whole-game target-table follow-up](INDIRECT_TARGET_TABLE_GAME_RESULTS.md) completes four accepted gameplay runs per game against the retained eight-target runtime. Snakes observes -0.39% CPU / +0.17% wall throughput (3.475x to 3.481x unpaced); Sky Force observes -0.05% CPU / -0.11% wall (2.903x to 2.900x). These fixed-2.4-GHz guest-time averages are effectively flat, not established gains; Snakes presents 2.56% fewer frames per wall second. All endpoints show gameplay, but scene/work differences remain. Startup, menu and sibling-interference attempts are retained separately. The final Snakes panel takes its unused SMT sibling offline and restores it afterward; all host settings restore. The O(1) candidate remains archived, with no runtime/default/LAN change.

state-pruning.note: Full ARM and Thumb load/store pruning

quiet-runtime-cuts.note: Verifier-disabled trusted dispatch omits unused work

ram-hit-inline.note: Compact dispatch already inlines the trusted hit and removes its old metadata pointer chase

guard-publication-omission.note: Integrated in quiet-runtime cuts for trusted execution

compiled-syscalls.note: Zero-return protocol; combined artifact +1.70% Snakes / +3.46% Sky Force versus current repository, all pairs faster

compiled-syscalls-long-snakes.note: Historical additional route used the older syscall protocol; current standard-game artifact comparison establishes adoption, not a new result on this route

sparse-rom-lookup.note: Sparse ROM index enabled in the measured winning combination; individual Sky Force +1.81% / Snakes -0.27%

entry-only-pruning.note: Current Snakes -0.42%; Sky Force +1.26% with mixed pairs and nearly unchanged native instruction count. Full pruning remains selected. Implementation and selector removed; see RETIRED_SWEEP_EXPERIMENTS.md.

whole-entry-budget.note: Current gains are mixed; outlined mode 2 has the stronger Snakes result and is selected for combined validation. Implementation and selector removed; see RETIRED_SWEEP_EXPERIMENTS.md.

outlined-entry-budget.note: Mode 2 enabled in the measured winning combination; full bounded entry with private precise recovery

batched-counts.note: Current Snakes -0.34% and Sky Force +0.50% with mixed pairs and slightly more native instructions; keep policy 17. Implementation and selector removed; see RETIRED_SWEEP_EXPERIMENTS.md.

current-tlb-vs-direct.note: The retained direct backend versus retained TLB on the frozen comparison build improves Snakes CPU throughput 29.35% and Sky Force 14.96%; all four pairs improve in each game. Native instructions fall 26.80% and 14.19%, respectively. All 16 observations and 88 restoration checks pass, with no invalid attempts. Direct is already the current default; retain it without claiming these historical percentages as additional current-runtime gains.

division-digits.note: Current combination: Snakes +0.07%, Sky Force -0.66% CPU, mixed pairs in both. Fewer Snakes native instructions did not yield a runtime gain. Implementation and selector removed; see RETIRED_SWEEP_EXPERIMENTS.md.

store-only-pruning.note: Small Snakes gain accompanied a Sky Force loss against the unpruned control; full pruning remains default

thumb-static.note: Snakes +0.91%, but Sky Force -1.84% with all four pairs slower; does not match the preferred tradeoff

cached-address-displacement.note: Controlled Snakes -0.27% CPU, 2/4 faster pairs; no current-runtime promotion proposed

deferred-read-exit.note: Controlled Snakes +0.46% CPU, 2/4 faster pairs; no current-runtime promotion proposed

owner-core-reuse.note: Current Snakes +0.15% CPU throughput with mixed pairs and +0.46% native instructions; Sky Force -0.82% with 2/4 faster pairs and +0.53% native instructions. No repeatable two-game gain; retain the graduated baseline.

aligned-cache-hash.note: Controlled Snakes +0.65% CPU, 3/4 faster pairs, native instructions +0.20%; current source retains the older hash; no default change

compact-generated-memory.note: Historical Snakes +8.05% CPU, native instructions -6.81%, 4/4 faster pairs. Current translator already uses the result-block/helper-exit structure; the historical page cache is gone and direct access is the default.

connected-callee-loops.status: Not selected on current two-game runtime
connected-callee-loops.note: Historical Snakes +6.87% does not carry over. Budget-preserving bound 64: +2.25% Snakes / -1.87% Sky Force. Bound 16: +2.05% / -1.79%. Neither tradeoff adopted; patches and exact correctness/timing evidence retained.

guarded-successor-lookup.note: Controlled Snakes -0.47% CPU, native instructions +3.22%, only 1/4 faster pairs. Current trusted dispatch also avoids the metadata pointer used by this older design.

expanded-leaf-eligibility.note: Forward-only scalar/multiply/branch expansion with browser leaf bound 32. Incremental Snakes +1.10% CPU, -2.04% native instructions, 4/4 faster pairs. Sky Force effectively neutral (+0.17%, mixed pairs). Exact measured artifact deployed after compiler and real gameplay checks; known host audio limitation persists.

call-prefix-fusion.note: Controlled Snakes -4.22% CPU throughput, native instructions +1.58%, all four pairs slower.

preserve-inner-leaves.note: Historical +3.94% Snakes CPU, 4/4 faster pairs, -2.83% native instructions. Recovers the rejected call-prefix regression; current default does not enable that path.

branch-veneer-fusion.note: Feature mask 160 retains literal-PC veneers and adds single-branch veneers at bound 32. Incremental current Snakes +0.87% CPU (3/4 faster), Sky Force +1.98% (4/4 faster). tail-prefix-fusion.note: Register-only terminal tails as mask 224 at bound 32, preserving full returning leaves. Current Snakes +2.32% CPU, -1.03% native instructions, all pairs faster. expanded-leaf-bound.note: Historical 16-to-32 expanded-leaf bound: Snakes +1.00% CPU, -0.85% native instructions, all four pairs faster. Browser defaults already select 32 in the separately validated current runtime. This completes historical evidence, not an additional incremental speedup or proof that 32 is optimal.

conditional-leaf-bound.note: Older conditional-only 16-to-32 bound: Snakes +0.12% CPU, -0.17% native instructions, 3/4 faster pairs with a -1.03% to +1.25% range. Adjustable limits removed; adopted constants are 512,32,8,512. See RETIRED_SWEEP_EXPERIMENTS.md.

Adjustable limits removed; adopted constants are 512,32,8,512. See RETIRED_SWEEP_EXPERIMENTS.md.

four-inline-sites.note: Historical eight-to-four inline-site cap: Snakes -2.03% CPU throughput, +3.28% native instructions, all four pairs slower (-0.76% to -3.82%). sixteen-inline-sites.note: Historical eight-to-sixteen inline-site cap: Snakes +0.26% CPU throughput, -0.04% native instructions, two faster and two slower pairs (-0.66% to +1.56%). No clear runtime gain; retain the current eight-site cap and do not claim it is globally optimal. Adjustable limits removed; adopted constants are 512,32,8,512. See RETIRED_SWEEP_EXPERIMENTS.md.

shorter-region-chain.note: Historical chain cap 512-to-64 regions: Snakes -1.26% CPU throughput, +0.68% native instructions, only one of four pairs faster. Retain the current 512-region cap; shorter chains do not earn current-runtime promotion. Adjustable limits removed; adopted constants are 512,32,8,512. See RETIRED_SWEEP_EXPERIMENTS.md.

uncapped-region-chain.note: Historical removal of the 512-region chain cap: Snakes +0.51% CPU throughput, two faster and two slower pairs (-0.40% to +1.50%), essentially identical native instructions (-0.00055%). No clear runtime win; retain 512. Guest budgets, IRQ/stop checks and successor validation remained enabled in the experiment. Adjustable limits removed; adopted constants are 512,32,8,512. See RETIRED_SWEEP_EXPERIMENTS.md.

eager-rom-regions.note: Historical eager ROM regions: Snakes +0.04% CPU (-0.65% native instructions, 1/4 faster pairs); Sky Force -0.73% CPU (-0.04% native instructions, 2/4 faster pairs). No current-runtime promotion warranted. Current startup ROM still uses bounded blocks; the related ROM-leaf combination is assessed separately.

rom-leaf-fusion.note: Historical ROM leaf fusion over eager regions: Snakes -0.52% CPU (2/4 faster pairs), Sky Force -1.71% (1/4 faster). Native instruction reductions are only about 0.03% in each game. Both means regress; no current-runtime promotion of the combined ROM strategy is warranted.

bounded-rom-calls.note: Current-runtime reassessment over 7f5f85273: Snakes -1.45% CPU throughput, Sky Force +0.26%; only 1/4 pairs faster in each game. Sky Force native instructions fall 0.38%, but three of four timing pairs lose and the small positive mean comes from one pair. This does not establish a repeatable Sky Force gain worth the measured Snakes loss. All 16 observations and 88 restoration checks pass. Retain the current deployed runtime; preserve the candidate patch and artifacts.

allocation-ranges.note: Allocation ranges versus historical TLB: Snakes -7.85% CPU throughput and +5.31% native instructions; Sky Force -18.78% and +17.11%. All four pairs lose in each game. Sixteen valid observations, zero invalid attempts, and all 88 restoration checks pass. No current-runtime port or default change is warranted.

full-page-table.status: Historical tradeoff; table retained within direct
full-page-table.note: Full page table versus historical TLB: Snakes +16.00% CPU throughput, -17.29% native instructions, 4/4 faster; Sky Force -5.01%, -2.57% native instructions, 0/4 faster. Sixteen valid observations and 88 restoration checks pass. Do not restore the standalone mode 3: its consistent Sky Force loss runs against the stated preference, and current mode 2 already retains the 1<<20 separate-read/write page table outside its faster arena (memory_experiment.cpp and memory_emission.h). This is a historical Snakes win, not a measured additional gain over current direct memory.

last-page-only.note: Last-page-only cache versus original 512-entry TLB: Snakes -5.67% CPU throughput despite -2.10% native instructions; Sky Force -19.00% with +10.37% native instructions. All four pairs lose in both games. Sixteen valid observations, no invalid attempts, and all 88 restoration checks pass. Retain the original TLB; do not restore the retired cache selector.

folded-tlb.note: Folded versus original TLB indexing: Snakes +6.51% CPU throughput and -6.92% native instructions, 4/4 faster pairs; Sky Force -2.79% and +0.73% native instructions, 0/4 faster. Sixteen valid observations and 88 restoration checks pass. This recovers a real historical Snakes benefit but consistently costs Sky Force performance, contrary to the stated tradeoff preference. Retain original indexing; no current-runtime graduation or restored selector.

tlb-plus-last-page.note: Original TLB plus scalar last-page cache versus TLB alone: Snakes +0.51% CPU throughput, -2.17% native instructions; Sky Force -0.22%, +0.39% native instructions. Each game has 3/4 faster pairs, but Sky Force final pair loses 2.68%; all valid observations are retained. No repeatable material two-game gain is established. Sixteen valid observations and 88 restoration checks pass. Current direct mode bypasses the historical ARM TLB cache path, so this is not an additional measured gain over default mode 2.

folded-tlb-plus-last-page.note: Folded TLB plus scalar last-page cache versus original TLB: Snakes +6.76% CPU throughput and -9.80% native instructions, 4/4 faster; Sky Force -2.17% and +0.88% native instructions, 0/4 faster. All 16 observations and 88 restoration checks pass. The combined caches retain the consistent Sky Force loss and do not justify replacing the current design. Preserve the historical Snakes result; no current-runtime graduation or retired selector restoration.

older-page-cache-guards.note: Older versus compact page-cache guards: Snakes -6.20% CPU throughput with +5.21% native instructions (0/4 faster pairs); Sky Force -0.95% with +1.65% instructions (1/4 faster). All 16 observations and 88 restoration checks pass. Retain compact guards. At this review gate the main runtime/test outputs were rebuilt after the rejected ROM-call source was restored; all six runtime artifact hashes exactly match deployed 7f5f85273.

page-cache-span-reuse.status: Historical Sky Force signal; inactive under direct
page-cache-span-reuse.note: Span reuse over retired folded-TLB plus last-page cache: Snakes -2.05% CPU throughput (0/4 faster), Sky Force +2.40% (3/4), with native instructions +1.12%/+0.87%. Sky Force pairs +5.66%, +8.52%, -4.27%, +0.08%; first-panel gains do not repeat in reverse order. All 16 observations and 88 restoration checks pass. Preserve this as a historical lead, not a current-default winner: cached_block_transfer_host depends on the removed READ_PAGE/WRITE_PAGE cache; current mode 2 routes scalar accesses through direct_access and whole spans through direct_host before TLB lowering. Restoring the old option would not optimize that active path. A direct-backend cache design would be a separate experiment; no additional current-runtime gain is established here.

tlb-unaligned-scalar.note: Replacing scalar TLB natural-alignment guards with page-boundary guards reduces Snakes CPU throughput 1.13% with all four pairs slower; Sky Force loses 0.41% with two faster and two slower pairs. Native instructions rise 0.10% and 0.68%, respectively. All 16 observations and 88 restoration checks pass, with no invalid attempts. Retain the existing TLB guard and the separately adopted direct-memory alignment lowering.
